description: This file defines the BudgetsProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages budget data within a Flutter application. It interfaces with a repository to load budgets and uses a use case for setting budget limits, facilitating state management and data updates for the budgeting feature.

classes.name: BudgetsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that provides budget data and operations within the Flutter app, including loading budgets and setting new budget limits.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads all budgets from the repository and notifies listeners to update UI.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Sets a new limit for a specific budget category using the use case and reloads budgets.
